_readme: Known answers for lint-carts' de:meta validator. Each case is fed to validateMeta() and its
label   what the case demonstrates (printed as the assertion name)
name    the cart filename stem — the slug must equal it
expect  a substring the error message MUST contain, or null to demand ZERO errors
only    true = demand EXACTLY one error, so the case proves it isn't riding along on
an unrelated second complaint from an otherwise-invalid meta
The vocabularies live in tools/lint-carts.js (kind/genre/status), tools/teaches-vocab.js and
tools/collections-vocab.js. This file deliberately uses REAL vocab values for the valid cases
('autotiling', 'road'): a fixture using made-up-but-accepted values would keep passing after

cases.label: a fully valid de:meta is silent  [cry-wolf guard]
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: the richest valid shape is silent too (all optionals, real vocab)
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: a missing slug is caught  [the PNG→source anchor]
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: a slug that doesn't match the filename stem is caught  [silent drift]
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: an empty-string slug is caught, not accepted as present
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: a missing title is caught
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: an off-vocabulary status is caught
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: a non-ISO created date is caught
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: an empty kind[] is caught
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: an off-vocabulary kind is caught
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: kind 'game' without a genre is caught  [the cross-field rule]
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: ...and kind 'game' WITH a genre is silent  [noise guard]
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: a genre on a non-game kind is legal  [not the inverse rule]
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: an off-vocabulary genre is caught
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: a missing teaches[] is caught (empty [] is the way to say 'nothing')
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: an empty teaches[] is legal  [exempt-class guard]
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: an off-vocabulary teaches tag is caught
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: an off-vocabulary collection slug is caught  [must anchor to a doc]
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: a description with ONLY controls is legal  [≥1 part is the rule]
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: a description object with no string part is caught
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: an empty-string description is caught, not accepted as present
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: an empty todo[] is caught (drop the field instead)
cases.name: fixcart
cases.expect: todo must be a non-empty string[]

cases.label: a blank todo entry is caught
cases.name: fixcart
cases.expect: todo entries must be non-empty strings

cases.label: a non-boolean resizable is caught
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: resizable: false is legal, not treated as absent-or-invalid
cases.name: fixcart

cases.label: an empty homage string is caught
cases.name: fixcart
cases.expect: homage must be a non-empty string
